column2: separate classifications in its statement of assets and liabilities.
A Pradeshiya Sabha shall classify an asset as current when:

(i) 
 it expects to realise the asset, or intends to consume, sell or distribute it, in the Pradeshiya Sabha’s

(ii) 
 it holds the asset primarily for the purpose of trading;

(iii) 
 it expects to realize the asset within twelve months after the reporting date; or
(iv)   the asset is cash or a cash equivalent, unless it is restricted from being exchanged or used to settle a
liability for at least twelve months after the reporting date.
